, Reason for Mistake: The Planner reversed Spanish surname conventions (the first surname is paternal, not maternal), incorrectly treating “de Marichalar” as the maternal line and thus naming the paternal grandmother instead of the confirmed maternal grandmother, Queen Sofía of Spain.
